content.title: Starting contribution
content.summary: Save real starting material with its author and origin for a later activity.
content.setup: Agree whose material starts the activity; the host supplies eligible contributors and a closing window.
content.participant: Submit one text, image, or audio starting contribution.
content.completion: Finish when the contribution window closes; the host can supply a real accepted contribution to another package.
content.access: Accepted contributions and attribution are group-visible. The host verifies source access for every later activity viewer.

provenance.rights: Authors retain rights to their contributions. This package grants no media rights.
